children: The intensity of ISOTeam's projects likely needs to improve, RHB Research's Alfie Yeo says in a research report. Its FY 2026 earnings were disappointing due to lower revenue recognition, characterized by a slower pace of projects, the analyst says. The intensity and progress of the facilities maintenance specialist's projects need to improve to sustain RHB's revenue growth expectations for ISOTeam. As the company has been affected by slower project intensity in FY 2026, RHB awaits ISOTeam's pace of projects to accelerate before turning more bullish on the stock. It lowers the stock's target price to 0.064 Singapore dollar from S$0.087 with an unchanged neutral rating. Shares are 2.9% lower at S$0.067. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
